  Exam Date & Time: 03-Jan-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech V Semester - Make up Examination, Jan-2025  
  SOFTWARE PROJECT MANAGEMENT [IT-3125]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Your team has developed a Product Flow Diagram for a new e-commerce platform.  
  However, during the initial review, stakeholders identified that certain products listed as  
  inputs are not included in the current version of the PFD. Evaluate how this omission       (5)  
  A)      could affect the project workflow and recommend steps to ensure comprehensive input  
  identification in future PFDs.  
  
  B)      A financial institution is developing a mobile banking application with a target size of  
  18,000 lines of code. Analyze the impact of skilled personnel costs, required hardware  
  infrastructure, and communication expenses with remote development teams on the total (3)  
  project cost  
  
  C)      Suppose you are in the initial phase of a project. Based on the feasibility study, you find  
  that the cost of the project may exceed the initial budget. Dissect and explain how this    (2)  
  discovery might impact your decision-making regarding project continuation.  
  
  2)           You are assigned to manage a software development project using PRINCE2  
  methodology. After creating the Product Breakdown Structure, you notice that one of the  
  critical products, the user documentation, was overlooked. Critique the potential impacts (5)  
  A)      of this oversight on project delivery and propose strategies to prevent similar issues in  
  future projects.  
  
  B)      A machine learning team has been tasked with developing a fraud detection system.  
  Devise a time-bound goal for this project. Infer the timeline considerations would they  
  need to address to ensure timely deployment while balancing quality and resource            (3)  
  limitations?  
  
  C)      A company's strategic plan emphasizes customer satisfaction as a key objective. If a  
  project proposal aims to develop a customer feedback platform, defend how would  
  senior management assess whether this project aligns with the organization's long-term      (2)  
  goal of enhancing customer satisfaction?  
  
  3)           Newspapers often report on the vast sums of money that are paid to the top executives of  
  many companies. Does this mean that these people are at a low level in the Maslow  
  (5)  
  hierarchy of motivation? Explain the Maslow's Motivation Model in detail.  
  A)

  B)         A startup plans to launch a mobile app connecting local farmers and consumers,  
  requiring both Android and iOS versions (20,000 lines of code). Predict the cost  
  implications of multi-platform development, hardware requirements, and the need for         (3)  
  external consultants.  
  
  C)         A healthcare provider is designing a patient management system using an "evolutionary"  
  prototype that will undergo multiple iterations based on user feedback. Interpret the  
  implications of this approach on resource allocation and delivery timelines, considering (2)  
  its impact on stakeholder confidence.  
  
  4)              Your organization has traditionally used an activity-based WBS, but feedback from  
  recent projects indicates that this approach often overlooks important deliverables.  
  Analyze the potential benefits of integrating a product focus into your existing WBS        (5)  
  A)         structure. Deduce an approach to balance the focus between products and activities to  
  ensure comprehensive project management.  
  
  B)         A startup plans to launch a mobile app connecting local farmers and consumers,  
  requiring both Android and iOS versions (20,000 lines of code). Evaluate the cost  
  implications of multi-platform development, hardware requirements, and the need for         (3)  
  external consultants.  
  
  C)         The company is managing several projects, including a cost-saving initiative and a new  
  product launch. Justify how should management prioritize these projects to ensure           (2)  
  resources are allocated effectively. Recommend one factor which they would consider.  
  
  5)              In order to carry out usability tests for a new word processing package, the software has  
  to be written and debugged. User instructions have to be available describing how the  
  package is to be used. These have to be scrutinized in order to plan and design the tests.  
  A)         Subjects who will use the package in the tests will need to be selected. As part of this  
  selection process, they will have to complete a questionnaire giving details of their past  
  experience of, and training in, typing and using word processing packages. The subjects  
  will carry out the required tasks using the word processing package. The tasks will be     (5)  
  timed and any problems the subjects encounter with the package will be noted. After the  
  test, the subjects will complete another questionnaire about what they felt about the  
  package. All the data from the tests will be sketched clearly and a report containing  
  recommendations for changes to the package will be drawn up. Dramatize the Work  
  Breakdown Structure for the above scenario.  
  
  B)         Infer the plan of diagnosing and addressing the communication issues within your team  
  to improve collaboration and project progress? Devise the steps you will take to ensure     (3)  
  that the team members communicate effectively and work cohesively.  
  
  C)         Illustrate the significance of risk identification in project management, and categorize  
  the techniques which can be used to effectively identify potential risks?                   (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
